interfaces.name: CitySeed
interfaces.signature: struct CitySeed: Identifiable, Codable, Hashable { let id: UUID; let city: String; let country: String; let lat: Double; let lon: Double; let timezoneIdentifier: String }
interfaces.notes: Bundled seed list row for onboarding city search.

interfaces.name: DistanceUnit
interfaces.signature: enum DistanceUnit: String, Codable { case km, mi }

interfaces.name: OnboardingPhase
interfaces.signature: enum OnboardingPhase { case nameAndCode, samplePartnerPreview, waitingForPartner, redeemCode, paired }

interfaces.name: AppSheet
interfaces.signature: enum AppSheet: String, Codable { case answerSheet, composeShare, timeline, reunion, settings, paywall, redeemCode, samplePreview }
interfaces.notes: Root-managed sheet routes; no freeform sheet strings.

interfaces.name: ConnectionState
interfaces.signature: enum ConnectionState { case none, sampleOnly, awaitingJoin, paired, activeReunion }
interfaces.notes: Derived navigation/state helper for Today and guard rails around pairing transitions.

interfaces.name: Person
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Person { var id: UUID; var name: String; var avatarTintHex: String; var homeCity: String; var homeLat: Double; var homeLon: Double; var timezoneIdentifier: String }
interfaces.notes: City-seed-selected only; no CoreLocation anywhere.

interfaces.name: Connection
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Connection { var id: UUID; var createdAt: Date; @Relationship var personMe: Person; @Relationship var personThem: Person; var isSample: Bool; var skin: Skin; var streakCount: Int; @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade) var cards: [Card] }
interfaces.notes: personThem is non-optional: this build always synthesizes both people locally at creation (sample or redeem-code), never models a networked pre-join gap. 'Primary' connection is derived from createdAt, never a stored field.

interfaces.name: Card
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Card { var id: UUID; @Relationship var connection: Connection; var dayIndex: Int; var promptID: UUID; var myAnswer: String?; var theirAnswer: String?; var myAnswerDraft: String?; var myAnsweredAt: Date?; var theirAnsweredAt: Date?; var simulatedPartnerAnswerDueAt: Date?; var distanceSnapshotKm: Double; var completedAt: Date? }
interfaces.notes: dayIndex is connection-relative (DayBoundary.canonicalDayIndex), unifying UTC-day-boundary math with the 60-day prompt-cycle modulo. myAnswerDraft is debounce-persisted (~2s) while the Answer sheet is open, cleared on submit/dismiss, to survive a force-quit.

interfaces.name: Prompt
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Prompt { var id: UUID; var text: String; var dayIndex: Int }
interfaces.notes: Bundled 60-day seed; Prompt for a Card is prompts[card.dayIndex % 60].

interfaces.name: Reunion
interfaces.signature: @Model final class Reunion { var id: UUID; @Relationship var connection: Connection; var targetDate: Date; var title: String }

interfaces.name: AppSettings
interfaces.signature: @Model final class AppSettings { var id: UUID; var activeConnectionID: UUID?; var units: DistanceUnit; var notificationCadence: NotificationCadence; var hasOnboarded: Bool }
interfaces.notes: Singleton row.

interfaces.name: CardDisplayState
interfaces.signature: struct CardDisplayState { let phase: CardPhase; let myAnswer: String?; let theirAnswer: String?; let distanceKm: Double; let promptText: String; let isRepeatPrompt: Bool; let streakBreakCause: StreakBreakCause? }

interfaces.name: StreakSummary
interfaces.signature: struct StreakSummary { let totalCompletionStreak: Int; let personalCompletionStreak: Int; let brokenByYou: Bool; let brokenByThem: Bool }
interfaces.notes: Separate attribution to avoid silent ambiguity on streak resets.

interfaces.name: SyncService
interfaces.signature: protocol SyncService { func todaysCard(for connectionID: UUID, now: Date) async throws -> Card; func submitAnswer(_ text: String, for cardID: UUID, now: Date) async throws -> Card; func startSimulatedPartnerTimer(for cardID: UUID, now: Date) async throws; func evaluateSimulatedPartnerDueCards(now: Date) async throws -> [Card]; func createSampleConnection(myName: String, city: CitySeed) async throws -> Connection; func createPairedConnectionViaRedeemCode(code: String, myName: String, theirName: String, theirCity: CitySeed) async throws -> Connection; func discardSampleConnection(sampleID: UUID, keeping keptID: UUID) async throws; func canCreateAdditionalConnection() async -> Bool }
interfaces.notes: LocalSyncService is the only active conformer; FirebaseSyncService remains doc-only.

interfaces.name: PromptProvider
interfaces.signature: protocol PromptProvider { func prompt(forDayIndex: Int) -> Prompt; func isRepeat(dayIndex: Int) -> Bool }

interfaces.name: GlobeDataService
interfaces.signature: protocol GlobeDataService { func coastlinePolylines() -> [[LatLon]]; func cities() -> [CitySeed]; func terminatorOffset(date: Date) -> CGFloat }

interfaces.name: EntitlementService
interfaces.signature: protocol EntitlementService { var isEntitled: Bool { get }; func refresh() async; func purchase(_ productID: String) async throws; func restore() async throws }
interfaces.notes: StoreKitEntitlementStore backed by Transaction.currentEntitlements/updates; never a cached boolean.

interfaces.name: HapticsService
interfaces.signature: protocol HapticsService { func fireHeartbeat(); func fireTick(); func fireSuccess() }
interfaces.notes: UIImpactFeedbackGenerator/UINotificationFeedbackGenerator backed; safely no-ops without hardware haptics.

interfaces.name: MotionAttitudeService
interfaces.signature: protocol MotionAttitudeService { func start(); func stop(); var orientationStream: AsyncStream<(yaw: Double, pitch: Double)> { get } }
interfaces.notes: Only ever consumed from within GlobeView's own state, never injected into AppRouter.

interfaces.name: CardExporter
interfaces.signature: protocol CardExporter { var supportedFormats: Set<ExportFormat> { get }; func export(scene: CardScene, skin: Skin) async throws -> ExportResult }
interfaces.notes: StaticPNGExporter (ImageRenderer-based) is the sole conformer this build; Compose & Share queries registration to decide the animated-toggle state.

interfaces.name: DateClock
interfaces.signature: protocol DateClock { func now() -> Date }
interfaces.notes: Injectable for SyncService checkpoints needing repeated fetches; one-shot pure functions take now: Date directly instead.

interfaces.name: ThemeSpec
interfaces.signature: struct ThemeSpec { let colors: ColorTokens; let typography: TypographyTokens; let spacing: SpacingTokens; let cornerRadius: CornerRadiusTokens }
interfaces.notes: Single token root; no inline Color/UIColor/.font(.system(size:) literals anywhere else.

interfaces.name: AppRouter
interfaces.signature: @MainActor @Observable final class AppRouter { var activeConnectionID: UUID?; var presentedSheet: PresentedSheet?; var onboardingPhase: OnboardingPhase; func hydrate() async; func present(_ sheet: PresentedSheet?); func dismissSheet(); func redeemJoinCode(_ code: String) async throws; func onSceneBecameActive() async }
interfaces.notes: Sole owner of cross-screen navigation state; redeemJoinCode no-ops/throws while presentedSheet != nil.

interfaces.name: computeCanonicalDayID
interfaces.signature: func computeCanonicalDayID(for date: Date, utcCalendar: Calendar = Calendar(identifier: .gregorian)) -> String
interfaces.notes: Canonical UTC day token used for card issuance and streak reset logic.

interfaces.name: resolveCardDisplayState
interfaces.signature: func resolveCardDisplayState(card: Card, connection: Connection, now: Date, clock: DateClock) -> CardDisplayState
interfaces.notes: Pure first-frame state function with no SwiftUI dependency.

interfaces.name: resolveDistanceKm
interfaces.signature: func resolveDistanceKm(from: (lat: Double, lon: Double), to: (lat: Double, lon: Double)) -> Double
interfaces.notes: Deterministic haversine distance for card snapshots.

interfaces.name: makeModelContainer
interfaces.signature: func makeModelContainer(inMemory: Bool, seedDemoData: Bool) throws -> ModelContainer
interfaces.notes: Built from SchemaV1; cloudKitDatabase: .none explicit.

interfaces.name: runDesignLint
interfaces.signature: func runDesignLint(in directory: String) throws -> [String]
interfaces.notes: CI gate script, not a new tool dependency.

interfaces.name: Skin
interfaces.signature: enum Skin: String, Codable, CaseIterable { case classicIndigo, aurora, blueprint, filmGrain, solstice }
interfaces.notes: Only classicIndigo unlocked pre-Tether+.

interfaces.name: NotificationCadence
interfaces.signature: enum NotificationCadence: String, Codable { case off, gentle, frequent }
interfaces.notes: In-app/foreground only; copy discloses this.

interfaces.name: LatLon
interfaces.signature: struct LatLon { let lat: Double; let lon: Double }
interfaces.notes: Deliberately not CLLocationCoordinate2D — no CoreLocation import anywhere.

interfaces.name: GlobeProjection
interfaces.signature: enum GlobeProjection { static func project(_ p: LatLon, center: LatLon) -> CGPoint?; static func isFrontFacing(_ p: LatLon, center: LatLon) -> Bool; static func greatCircleArc(from: LatLon, to: LatLon, samples: Int) -> [LatLon]; static func haversineKm(_ a: LatLon, _ b: LatLon) -> Double }
interfaces.notes: Pure geometry, CoreGraphics/Foundation only, no SwiftUI/SwiftData import.

interfaces.name: DayBoundary
interfaces.signature: enum DayBoundary { static func canonicalDayIndex(for date: Date, connectionCreatedAt: Date) -> Int }
interfaces.notes: UTC canonical day boundary at the Connection level; single source for Card.dayIndex.

interfaces.name: StreakCalculator
interfaces.signature: enum StreakCalculator { static func currentStreak(cards: [Card], asOfDayIndex: Int) -> StreakResult }

interfaces.name: StreakResult
interfaces.signature: struct StreakResult { let personalStreak: Int; let connectionStreak: Int; let brokenBy: StreakBreakCause? }

interfaces.name: StreakBreakCause
interfaces.signature: enum StreakBreakCause { case me, them, both }
interfaces.notes: Must be surfaced in UI, never silently applied.

interfaces.name: EntitlementPolicy
interfaces.signature: enum EntitlementPolicy { static func canWrite(to connection: Connection, allConnections: [Connection], isEntitled: Bool) -> Bool }
interfaces.notes: Single domain policy point; derives 'primary' from earliest createdAt, never a stored flag. All Card/Connection mutation paths route through this.

interfaces.name: CardPhase
interfaces.signature: enum CardPhase: String { case samplePartnerWaiting, awaitingYou, awaitingThem, complete, streakBrokenAttributed }

interfaces.name: cardDisplayState
interfaces.signature: func cardDisplayState(card: Card, connection: Connection, prompt: Prompt, now: Date) -> CardDisplayState
interfaces.notes: Pure, SwiftUI-free, injectable now; the core first-frame-legibility seam.

interfaces.name: CardScene
interfaces.signature: struct CardScene { let displayState: CardDisplayState; let projectedTetherPoints: [CGPoint]; let endpointMe: CGPoint?; let endpointThem: CGPoint?; let accessibilitySummary: String }
interfaces.notes: Single source read by the live globe draw, the VoiceOver label, and StaticPNGExporter — the on-screen and exported card can never visually diverge.

interfaces.name: buildCardScene
interfaces.signature: func buildCardScene(displayState: CardDisplayState, connection: Connection, viewportSize: CGSize, parallax: GlobeParallax) -> CardScene

interfaces.name: GlobeParallax
interfaces.signature: struct GlobeParallax { var yawDegrees: Double; var pitchDegrees: Double }
interfaces.notes: Lives only in GlobeView's private @State — never in AppRouter or anything @Query-observed.

interfaces.name: PresentedSheet
interfaces.signature: enum PresentedSheet: Identifiable { case answer(UUID); case composeShare(UUID); case timeline; case reunion; case connectionsSettings; case paywall(PaywallTrigger); case redeemCode }

interfaces.name: PaywallTrigger
interfaces.signature: enum PaywallTrigger { case animatedExport, addConnection, openReunion }
interfaces.notes: The exact three locked triggers.

interfaces.name: ExportResult
interfaces.signature: struct ExportResult { let pngData: Data; let suggestedFilename: String }

interfaces.name: AccessibilitySummaryBuilder
interfaces.signature: enum AccessibilitySummaryBuilder { static func summary(for scene: CardScene, connection: Connection) -> String }
interfaces.notes: e.g. 'You are 2,847 km from Sam. Card complete.' Feeds CardScene.accessibilitySummary.

interfaces.name: DraftPersistence
interfaces.signature: func persistDraft(_ text: String, on card: Card, debounce: Duration) async
interfaces.notes: debounce-writes Card.myAnswerDraft every ~2s while Answer sheet is open; closes the force-quit-loses-draft gap

interfaces.name: SchemaV1
interfaces.signature: enum SchemaV1: VersionedSchema { static var models: [any PersistentModel.Type] { [Person.self, Connection.self, Card.self, Prompt.self, Reunion.self, AppSettings.self] } }
interfaces.notes: Declared now so the first real migration is additive.

interfaces.name: persistDraft
interfaces.signature: func persistDraft(_ text: String, on card: Card, debounce: Duration) async
interfaces.notes: Debounce-writes Card.myAnswerDraft every ~2s while the Answer sheet is open; closes the force-quit-loses-draft gap.

interfaces.name: ExportFormat
interfaces.signature: enum ExportFormat { case staticPNG, animatedMP4, livePhoto }
